Clone discovery within a trunk

Source: R/clones_discovery.R
discover_within.Rd

Second level of the hierarchical discovery of caller_tumour(). The phase blocks are oriented by the pseudobulk of the trunk's cells only (leave-one-out, discovery half of the votes): a subclonal event carried by 5-25 % of a trunk is oriented correctly in most blocks, while in the all-cell pseudobulk it is outweighed by balanced cells. Features: per region (classes of feat_disc) the signed allelic z and the depth z, kept only for regions whose allelic z varies across the trunk's cells beyond the null (variance > disp_min; unit variance expected) or is imbalanced on average (|mean| > imb_min): allelic features select the regions, depth is used only where the allele channel shows a clone-level event (a loss vs a gain of the same haplotype differ only in depth there). Discovery (discover_clones()) runs on the trunk's deeper cells (n_frag >= the deep_q quantile, at least 4 * min_size cells), whose per-cell profiles separate subclones; merge_clones() then tests every pair of leaves (n_nb = Inf) on the test halves (cdata). Shallow cells are left to the likelihood assignment.

Usage

discover_within(
  inp,
  tcells,
  votes_disc,
  feat_disc,
  cdata,
  n_frag,
  opts = clone_defaults(),
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

inp

a clone_input

tcells

trunk cells

votes_disc

discovery half of the votes (split_votes())

feat_disc

per-cell depth features of the discovery half (cell, region, z)

cdata

contrast_data() of the test halves (all cells)

n_frag

named clean fragments per cell

opts

clone_defaults()

seed

RNG seed

Value

list(clones = named integer labels of the discovery cells, tests, regions = selected regions, n_leaves)
